from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();d=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1'
p=root/'docs/PROJECT_STATE.md';raw=p.read_bytes();s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8');tail=s[s.index('## 12.'):]
row=next(x for x in s.splitlines() if x.startswith('| 季度长端国债供给 |'))
s=s.replace('\n\n'+row+'\n\n','\n\n',1)
reference=next(x for x in s.splitlines() if x.startswith('| 美国利率/政策意外 |'))
s=s.replace(reference,reference+'\n'+row,1)
assert s[s.index('## 12.'):]==tail and p.read_bytes()==raw
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
record={'state_table_row_moved_into_existing_table':True,'state_before_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'state_after_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'other_branch_tail_preserved':True,'config_relative_paths':{}}
for rel in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']:
 p=root/rel;raw=p.read_bytes();obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));changes={}
 for k,v in obj.items():
  if isinstance(v,str) and v.startswith(root.as_posix()+'/reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/'):
   changes[k]={'before':v,'after':Path(v).relative_to(root).as_posix()};obj[k]=changes[k]['after']
 assert p.read_bytes()==raw
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
 record['config_relative_paths'][rel]=changes
(d/'文档格式与路径整理回执.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('来源行已并入原表，配置路径保持项目相对格式；没有改变研究参数或目标。')
